story.headline: About 800,000 Colorado ballots wrongly include the Front Range Passenger Rail tax question
story.summary: About 800,000 voters outside the Front Range Passenger Rail District in Adams, Arapahoe, Douglas and Weld counties were sent ballots that include Issue 7A, the district's proposed sales tax. The district apologized to the four county clerks' offices, saying its new boundaries were not communicated through the usual channels. The Secretary of State's office says only votes from eligible district residents will be counted.

quote.text: The Front Range Passenger Rail District apologized in a letter to the four county clerks offices for a lack of communication that led to the error.
